messages:
harry (People Ops): Quick All-Hands follow-up thread on hybrid & travel ops. Capturing answers to the common Qs that came up: ride reimbursement, hotel early-check-in, desk hoteling, accessibility, childcare stipends, and etiquette for team collab days. I'll post the FAQ link once this is finalized.

julia (Product): For hotel bookings  will the company continue to book group blocks or should we book individually and expense? Any early check-in stipend for red-eye travelers?

viv (Finance): We'll continue to secure group blocks for company-funded offsites where possible. If you book individually for a company-approved trip, expense the room with the confirmed booking code. Early check-in is reimbursable up to $40 if flight arrival before 8am requires it. Include receipt and note on the expense form.

elaine (VP Eng): For leadership: can managers grant one-off late checkout/early-checkin exceptions? Some teammates are on tight travel windows.

harry (People Ops): Managers can approve early-checkin/late-checkout exceptions in the pre-approval form; People Ops will fast-track those for accessibility or family reasons.

tom (SRE): Rides: is there a per-trip cap for airport->hub? Also, we sometimes need a van for gear (test racks).

viv (Finance): Standard cap $85 one-way for airport transfers in metro areas. Vans/XL require manager pre-approval and a short justification. Tips up to 20% reimbursable. Batch uploads allowed but include individual receipt lines.

sam (Facilities): Parking: satellite hubs have limited reserved loading zones. For equipment drops, submit a parking-exemption request 48 hours in advance. We can arrange an escort for curbside unloading.

julia (Product): Childcare stipend pilot question: any update? Some parents asked at All-Hands.

harry (People Ops): People Ops is running a childcare travel stipend pilot for the July/Aug product offsites: $175 per family with receipt. Pilot only for company-funded events and requires manager OK. We'll assess demand before expanding.

elaine (VP Eng): Accessibility: will quiet rooms and ergonomic chairs be available at hubs during offsites? Need to ensure our teammate with sensory needs is accommodated.

harry (People Ops): Yes  request accommodations via the accommodations form and tag it as "offsite". Facilities will reserve quiet rooms and ergonomic setups; People Ops will prioritize these requests. No PR required.

tom (SRE): Desk hoteling: any change to booking windows? Our team does pairing days and needs predictable desks.

sam (Facilities): New booking rules: reservations open 7 days prior. Individual users can reserve up to 4 days in any rolling 21-day window. Teams can request a temporary block (up to 6 desks) with 7 business days notice. We keep 12% of desks unscheduled for same-day drop-ins. Recurring weekly blocks require manager sign-off and are limited to once-per-week per team.

julia (Product): Etiquette: how much notice should we give for a team collab day so remote folks can plan travel?

harry (People Ops): Recommended: 72 hours for team-level collab days, 2 weeks for cross-team workshops, and 4 weeks for offsite travel that requires flights/visas. Leadership asks teams to post collab days on the shared calendar and put a short note in the team channel.

viv (Finance): Expense tip: always include project code and event name on the expense. This speeds approvals. Reimbursements processed within 5 business days.

sam (Facilities): Offsite logistics: we're evaluating a shuttle from the main airport, partner hotel rates, and a "buddy" program for first-time offsite attendees (volunteer mentors to meet newcomers at arrival). Will publish a planning doc soon.

calendar-bot: Provisional event "Product Working Offsite (Tentative)" Aug 18-19 created on company calendar. RSVP optional.

harry (People Ops): Actions: I'll update the People Ops FAQ with hotel/ride caps, booking links, accommodations form, childcare pilot details, and the buddy program note. DM me for special cases or urgent visa/guest requests. :raised_hands:

elaine (VP Eng): Thanks Harry  useful.

julia (Product): Thanks everyone.

tom (SRE): Appreciated.

sam (Facilities): Will publish seating map and loading instructions for SF hub tomorrow.
